    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`This configuration enables you to add custom input controls to the attachment upload dialog, allowing users to capture additional DOCLINK attributes (like default flags, analysis requirements, scores, or document types) at the time of attachment upload. This eliminates the need for separate editing steps after upload and ensures consistent metadata capture.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Mark attachments as default/primary during upload (e.g., default CAD drawing for an asset)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Flag attachments for automated processing (e.g., photos requiring AI analysis)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Capture document classification or scoring during upload`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Set custom metadata fields required by business processes`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Prerequisites:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Application must use the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`touch`}</inlineCode>{` theme`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Basic understanding of Graphite XML components and event handlers`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Access to modify application XML and controller files`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Custom attributes must be valid DOCLINK fields in the object structure`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Enable custom options in the attachment list`}</h3>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`allow-naming`}</inlineCode>{` attribute must be set to `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`true`}</inlineCode>{` on the attachment-list component to enable the custom options feature. This allows the attachment dialog to display additional controls beyond the standard file selection and description fields.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<attachment-list 
  id="attachmentList1" 
  datasource="attachmentds" 
  allow-naming="true"
  file-name-required="false" 
  file-desc-required="false"
  show-folder-list="false" 
  hide-when-empty="false" 
  is-editable="true"
  show-managed-header="true"
  default-folder="CAD" 
  record-marker-field-name="isdefault" 
  record-marker-field-value="true"
  record-marker-icon="carbon:star--filled" 
  check-deletable-item="checkDeletableItem"
>
  <!-- Custom options will be added in next step -->
</attachment-list>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Expected Result:`}</strong>{`
The attachment list is now configured to support custom controls in the upload dialog.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Add custom controls using the custom-options slot`}</h3>
    <p>{`Define one or more custom controls within the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`custom-options`}</inlineCode>{` slot. Supported control types are: `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`text-input`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`number-input`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`checkbox`}</inlineCode>{`, and `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`toggle`}</inlineCode>{`. Each control must specify an event handler and the target DOCLINK attribute name.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<attachment-list 
  id="attachmentList1" 
  datasource="attachmentds" 
  allow-naming="true"
  file-name-required="false" 
  file-desc-required="false"
  show-folder-list="false" 
  hide-when-empty="false" 
  is-editable="true"
  show-managed-header="true"
  default-folder="CAD" 
  record-marker-field-name="isdefault" 
  record-marker-field-value="true"
  record-marker-icon="carbon:star--filled" 
  check-deletable-item="checkDeletableItem"
>
  <!-- Checkbox: Set attachment as default/primary -->
  <checkbox 
    slot="custom-options" 
    label="Set as default" 
    default-checked="true" 
    checked="false"
    on-change="setAsDefault" 
    on-change-arg="isdefault" 
    id="ybm3n"
  />
  
  <!-- Toggle: Flag for automated analysis -->
  <toggle 
    slot="custom-options" 
    label="Analyse photo" 
    toggle-label-off="No" 
    toggle-label-on="Yes"
    type="TrueFalse" 
    toggled="{page.state.analysePhoto}" 
    on-toggle="setAnalysePhoto"
    on-toggle-arg="inferreq" 
    id="bmyx8"
  />
  
  <!-- Number Input: Capture quality or priority score -->
  <number-input 
    slot="custom-options" 
    id="zaxve" 
    label="Score" 
    min="1" 
    max="10" 
    value="5" 
    on-change="setScore"
    on-change-arg="score"
  />
  
  <!-- Text Input: Document type classification -->
  <text-input 
    slot="custom-options" 
    id="doctype1" 
    label="Type" 
    value="Images" 
    on-change="setDocType"
    on-change-arg="doctype"
  />
</attachment-list>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important Notes:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Controls appear below the description field (or below folder list if enabled)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`on-change`}</inlineCode>{` and `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`on-change-arg`}</inlineCode>{` for text-input, number-input, and checkbox`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`on-toggle`}</inlineCode>{` and `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`on-toggle-arg`}</inlineCode>{` for toggle controls`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`*-arg`}</inlineCode>{` attribute specifies the DOCLINK attribute name to update`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Expected Result:`}</strong>{`
When users click to add an attachment, they will see the custom controls in the upload dialog.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Step 3: Implement event handlers in the controller`}</h3>
    <p>{`Create event handlers for each custom control. Each handler receives two parameters: the attribute name and the event object. The handler must call `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`event.onUpdate(attributeName, value)`}</inlineCode>{` to save the value with the attachment.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`JavaScript Implementation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Handler for checkbox control - sets default flag
 * @param {string} attr - The DOCLINK attribute name (e.g., 'isdefault')
 * @param {Object} event - Event object with value property
 */
setAsDefault(attr, event) {
  const TAG = 'AttachmentCustomOptions';
  this.app.log.i(TAG, 'setAsDefault: ', attr + '=' + event?.value);
  
  // Update the attachment payload with the attribute value
  event.onUpdate(attr, event?.value);
}

/**
 * Handler for toggle control - sets analysis flag
 * @param {string} attr - The DOCLINK attribute name (e.g., 'inferreq')
 * @param {Object} event - Event object with target.checked property
 */
setAnalysePhoto(attr, event) {
  const TAG = 'AttachmentCustomOptions';
  this.app.log.i(TAG, 'setAnalysePhoto: ', attr + '=' + event?.target?.checked);
  
  // Update page state for UI binding
  this.page.state.analysePhoto = event?.target?.checked;
  
  // Update the attachment payload with the boolean value
  event.onUpdate(attr, event?.target?.checked);
}

/**
 * Handler for number input control - sets score
 * @param {string} attr - The DOCLINK attribute name (e.g., 'score')
 * @param {Object} event - Event object with value property
 */
setScore(attr, event) {
  const TAG = 'AttachmentCustomOptions';
  this.app.log.i(TAG, 'setScore: ', attr + '=' + event?.value);
  
  // Update the attachment payload with the numeric value
  event.onUpdate(attr, event?.value);
}

/**
 * Handler for text input control - sets document type
 * @param {string} attr - The DOCLINK attribute name (e.g., 'doctype')
 * @param {Object} event - Event object with value property
 */
setDocType(attr, event) {
  const TAG = 'AttachmentCustomOptions';
  this.app.log.i(TAG, 'setDocType: ', attr + '=' + event?.value);
  
  // Update the attachment payload with the text value
  event.onUpdate(attr, event?.value);
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important Notes:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Toggle controls use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`event.target.checked`}</inlineCode>{` (boolean)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Other controls use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`event.value`}</inlineCode>{` (string or number)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Always call `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`event.onUpdate(attr, value)`}</inlineCode>{` to persist the value`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`The attribute and value are included in the save payload automatically`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Expected Result:`}</strong>{`
When users upload an attachment, the custom attribute values are saved to the DOCLINK record in Maximo.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Step 4: Ensure attributes are in the object structure`}</h3>
    <p>{`Verify that all custom attributes used in the controls are included in the attachment datasource’s object structure. Both persistent and non-persistent DOCLINK attributes are supported.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Location in app.xml:`}</strong>{`
Find your attachment datasource definition and ensure the schema includes your custom attributes:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="attachmentds" object-structure="MXAPIDOCLINKS">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="docinfoid" id="attr_001"/>
    <attribute name="description" id="attr_002"/>
    <attribute name="urlname" id="attr_003"/>
    <!-- Custom attributes for custom-options -->
    <attribute name="isdefault" id="attr_004"/>
    <attribute name="inferreq" id="attr_005"/>
    <attribute name="score" id="attr_006"/>
    <attribute name="doctype" id="attr_007"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Expected Result:`}</strong>{`
The datasource can properly save and retrieve the custom attribute values.`}</p>
